title: Staging Gatekeeper Record (preview or refusal)
x_note: The staging-gatekeeper's output for every order request (BL-011). PASS = a preview; FAIL = a refusal. Every record is AEGIS-tagged (D-17) and carries the mechanical check result (BL-009).

requested_by.description: the desk/persona that requested — never the gatekeeper itself

checks.description: the 7-check framework result, mechanically verified (BL-009 gate_check.py); the agent only relays this

first_failed_check.description: non-null on REFUSED — the first check that failed

autopilot_armed.description: whether this ran under an armed switch
